questions.group: 2016-12-04 考试回忆 · 逻辑推理
questions.passage:
Upon maturity, monarch butterflies travel hundreds of miles from their places of
origin and lay their eggs on milkweed. The caterpillars that emerge feed on
milkweed and absorb the glycosides in milkweed sap. The specific glycosides
present in milkweed differ from region to region within the monarch butterfly’s
range. Mature butterflies retain the glycosides in a mature monarch butterfly could
be used to determine its place of origin.
questions.prompt: Which of the following, if true, most strengthens the argument?

options.label: A
options.text:
Mature monarch butterflies do not feed on parts of milkweed that contain
glycosides.

options.label: B
options.text: The glycosides in milkweed sap are slightly toxic to caterpillars of other species.

options.label: C
options.text:
The vast majority of the monarch butterflies that are laying eggs in a given
region will have traveled there from a single region.

options.label: D
options.text:
There are substances other than glycosides in milkweed sap that accumulate in a
monarch caterpillar and are retained in the body of the mature butterfly.

options.label: E
options.text:
There are certain glycosides that are found in the sap of all milkweeds, no matter
where they grow within the monarch butterfly’s range.

questions.explanation: 只有C 选项是加强了上文的论点。A 削弱 B 无关 D 削弱 E 削弱
